economic_thesis: When the causal common-market path and cross-sectional breadth are coherent, slow information diffusion and inventory adjustment produce residual continuation; when the path is inefficient and breadth fragmented, temporary liquidity imbalances produce residual reversal. Realized perpetual funding identifies crowded expensive positioning and should improve long/short carry without forecasting funding.

expected_regime_roles.bear: Negative causal market direction increases short gross while persistent residual losers and high-funding contracts populate the short sleeve; short attribution is expected positive.
expected_regime_roles.bull: Positive causal market direction increases long gross while persistent uncrowded residual winners populate the long sleeve; long attribution is expected positive.
expected_regime_roles.chop: Low persistence shifts the score toward short-horizon residual reversal, near-neutral side budgets, and realized-funding carry; combined portfolio return is expected positive.
expected_regime_roles.long_sleeve: Long the highest composite ranks, favoring persistent residual strength in coherent markets, oversold residuals in fragmented markets, and low/negative realized funding; gross remains materially active in every state.
expected_regime_roles.short_sleeve: Short the lowest composite ranks, favoring persistent residual weakness in coherent markets, overbought residuals in fragmented markets, and high positive realized funding; gross remains materially active in every state.
expected_regime_roles.stress: Residualization and inverse-volatility sizing limit common-beta concentration; organizer-owned volatility targeting and drawdown brakes seek approximately flat-to-modestly-positive behavior and bounded tails, without claiming crisis alpha.

falsifier: Reject the mechanism if fewer than four of six chronological folds show the preregistered positive trend-high-persistence/reversal-low-persistence IC interaction, or funding fails to reduce net carry paid in at least four folds. Reject economically if fewer than four folds are profitable after base costs, required regime/sleeve signs or doubled-cost viability fail, or fewer than 70% of declared neighbors are profitable; no aggregate metric compensates.
mechanism: At each daily rebalance, use only transaction closes and realized funding through t-8h for the current point-in-time Top-40. Remove a rolling median-market beta, rank medium/fast residual trend and short residual reversal, blend them with a smooth causal market-efficiency/breadth persistence state, then add a realized-funding carry rank. Long the top ranks and short the bottom ranks with inverse-volatility sleeve weights; smoothly tilt but never extinguish either side using past common-market direction.
risk_policy_plan: Freeze the selected signal before a full 2^3 factorial of 20-day 35% volatility target, 10/20/27.5% drawdown brakes, and 0.25 one-way turnover limit. Evaluate none, individuals, pairs, and combined under base and doubled costs. Keep same-boundary reentry false; position/time stops disabled. Retain only a subset that improves drawdown or 5% tail loss at least 10%, loses at most 0.10 Sharpe, and preserves every gate.
selection_metric: Non-compensatory gate pass first; then lexicographically maximize positive-fold count, worst-fold net Sharpe, median-fold net Sharpe, doubled-cost Sharpe, and Calmar; then minimize maximum drawdown and turnover, with bytewise candidate_id as final tie-break. Require the causal sign tests and profitable-neighbor fraction before selection.
